successCriteria.description: Barrel file at `src/modules/audit/index.ts` re-exports all public symbols: `AuditLog` and `IAuditRepository` from `audit.model.ts`, `AuditRepository` from `audit.repository.ts`, and `AuditService` from `audit.service.ts` — following the exact re-export pattern of `src/modules/employee/index.ts` and `src/modules/policy/index.ts`.

Barrel file at `src/modules/notification/index.ts` re-exports all public symbols: `Notification` and `INotificationRepository` from `notification.model.ts`, `NotificationRepository` from `notification.repository.ts`, and `NotificationService` from `notification.service.ts` — following the exact re-export pattern of `src/modules/employee/index.ts` and `src/modules/policy/index.ts`.

Unit test file `tests/unit/modules/audit/audit.service.spec.ts` exists and passes. It mocks `IAuditRepository` using `jest.Mocked<IAuditRepository>` with fresh mocks per test (following the pattern in `employee.service.spec.ts`). Tests: (a) `log()` calls `repository.create` with the entry and returns the created `AuditLog`; (b) `getEntityHistory()` calls `repository.findByEntity` with correct `entityType` and `entityId` and returns results; (c) `getUserActions()` calls `repository.findByPerformer` with correct `performedBy` and optional `limit`, and returns results.

Unit test file `tests/unit/modules/notification/notification.service.spec.ts` exists and passes. It mocks `INotificationRepository` using `jest.Mocked<INotificationRepository>` with fresh mocks per test. Tests: (a) `send()` calls `repository.create` with correct fields (`recipientId`, `title`, `body`, `type`, `metadata` defaulting to `null` when omitted) and returns the created `Notification`; (b) `getForUser()` calls `repository.findByRecipient` with correct `recipientId` and optional `limit`, and returns results; (c) `markRead()` calls `repository.markAsRead` with correct `id`.

constraints: Barrel files must use named re-exports only (no `export * from` wildcards), matching the pattern in `src/modules/employee/index.ts` and `src/modules/policy/index.ts`.

Unit tests must import from the barrel file (`modules/audit/audit.service` → `AuditService`, `modules/audit/audit.model` → `IAuditRepository`/`AuditLog`), not from internal source files directly, matching the import style in `employee.service.spec.ts` and `policy.service.spec.ts`.

Test mocks must use `jest.Mocked<T>` for the repository interface and `jest.fn()` for each method, with `beforeEach` resetting mocks to a fresh state — matching the pattern in existing service spec files.
No new dependencies may be added to `package.json` — Jest and ts-jest are already configured and sufficient.
outOfScope: Controllers, routes, HTTP handlers, or any HTTP surface for audit or notification modules — these are deferred per ARCHITECTURE.md.
Database migrations for `audit_logs` or `notifications` tables — assumed to exist.
Integration tests or end-to-end tests — only unit tests for the service layer are in scope for this sub-phase.

entityInvariants.invariant: AuditLog records are immutable — the repository exposes only `create`, `findByEntity`, and `findByPerformer`; no update or delete operations exist. The `performedAt` timestamp is set by the repository on creation, not by the caller.

Notifications are immutable after creation except for the `isRead` field, which transitions exactly once from `false` to `true` via `markAsRead`. The `markAsRead` operation is idempotent — calling it on an already-read notification is safe and produces no error. If the notification does not exist, the operation silently does nothing (no throw).

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Delegates directly to IAuditRepository.create. No domain errors thrown by the service itself — any errors propagate from the repository layer.
Read-only, delegates to IAuditRepository.findByEntity. Returns empty array when no records exist.
Read-only, delegates to IAuditRepository.findByPerformer. Optional `limit` parameter is passed through to the repository. Returns empty array when no records exist.
Delegates to INotificationRepository.create. `metadata` defaults to `null` when omitted. No domain errors thrown by the service itself.
Read-only, delegates to INotificationRepository.findByRecipient. Optional `limit` parameter is passed through. Returns empty array when no notifications exist.
Delegates to INotificationRepository.markAsRead. Idempotent — safe to call on already-read notifications. Does not throw if the notification does not exist.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Barrel file `src/modules/audit/index.ts` must follow the exact named-export pattern of `src/modules/employee/index.ts`: export model interfaces/types from the model file, repository class from the repository file, and service class from the service file — no wildcard re-exports.

Barrel file `src/modules/notification/index.ts` must follow the exact named-export pattern of `src/modules/employee/index.ts`: export model interfaces/types from the model file, repository class from the repository file, and service class from the service file — no wildcard re-exports.

Audit service unit tests must follow the structure of `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.service.spec.ts`: `jest.Mocked<IAuditRepository>` mock with `jest.fn()` per method, `beforeEach` creating fresh mocks, and tests verifying correct delegation arguments and return values.

Notification service unit tests must follow the structure of `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.service.spec.ts`: `jest.Mocked<INotificationRepository>` mock with `jest.fn()` per method, `beforeEach` creating fresh mocks, and tests verifying correct delegation arguments and return values.
